payload.title: Hapa Card Relationship Lab board initialized
payload.body: App board created for the Card Card feature. Initial prototype is source-anchored from Second Brain counts, Hapa dev proto card-detail protocol, Hapa wiki card taxonomy, and the existing 3D card table scene.

payload.title: Review Second Brain and protocol sources
payload.description: Inspect source databases and protocol/card docs for relationship model requirements.
acceptance: Relevant database tables are named.
Card model and detail-view protocol are inspected.
Counts are recorded for graph seed.

payload.title: Scaffold Hapa Card Relationship Lab
payload.description: Fork the existing card table prototype into a standalone Vite/Three Hapa operator app.
acceptance: Vite/Three app runs independently.
Original card-table prototype remains untouched.
Public visual assets are reused.

payload.title: Implement Card Detail View focus panel
payload.description: Select one card, bring it into focus, and expose relationship/evidence/protocol details in the attached menu.
acceptance: Selecting a card focuses the 3D object.
Detail menu shows metrics, relations, evidence, and protocol.
Relationship lists expose incoming and outgoing edges.

payload.title: Generate live graph snapshots from Second Brain
payload.description: Build a read-only SQLite export path so the browser app can load graph JSON snapshots instead of static seed data.
acceptance: Read-only SQLite exporter emits graph JSON.
Snapshot includes source table, generated_at, and row counts.
Browser app loads snapshot without direct DB access.

payload.title: Register app board and checkpoint
payload.description: Register the Card Card app in the standard Overwatch Kanban config/seed surfaces.
acceptance: Overwatch events log exists.
Local board file mirrors current tasks.
Checkpoint records verified and inferred scope.

payload.title: Add relationship actions for promotion
payload.description: Add explicit read-only preview actions for promoting relationship edges into durable Hapa card/protocol stores.
acceptance: Promotion actions are read-only previews first.
Writeback requires explicit authority and rollback notes.
Actions preserve card provenance.

payload.title: Initial board checkpoint
payload.summary: Card Card app board registered with source review, scaffold, detail-view, live-export, registration, and relationship-promotion work cards.
verified: Second Brain counts recorded
Hapa card/detail docs reviewed
3D table scaffold copied into standalone app
Standard board files created
open: Run frontend build and browser smoke test
Promote Card Detail View task after verification

payload.reason: Card focus selection, relation/evidence/protocol tabs, incoming/outgoing links, and clickable related cards are implemented and browser-checked.
Project config, seed event log, local board, and initial checkpoint are written.

payload.title: Build and browser smoke-test prototype
acceptance: Production build passes.
In-app browser loads the local dev server.
Canvas, detail panel, filters, and board render without horizontal overflow.

payload.title: Prototype build and browser smoke checkpoint
payload.summary: The Card Relationship Lab builds and opens in the in-app browser. Desktop check selected the Hapa Card / Artifact System Design skill card, displayed Evidence details, and focused the 3D card. Mobile-width check had no horizontal overflow.
verified: npm run build passed
In-app browser saw one canvas, 16 card rows, 5 board columns, and detail tabs
Desktop and 390px viewport smoke checks passed
open: Static graph seed should become a read-only SQLite snapshot exporter
Relationship promotion actions remain backlog and require explicit authority

payload.title: Add card-type and scope abstraction layer
payload.description: Resolve card kind, scope, and visual container through reusable profiles instead of one-off renderer cases.
acceptance: Renderer resolves kind, scope, and container through profiles.
All known Hapa card families have type descriptions.
UI shows size/scope without flooding the graph.

payload.title: Add Protocol Cards and utilization relationships
payload.description: Seed Protocol Cards from Second Brain protocol rows and show how protocols utilize other card types.
acceptance: Second Brain protocol counts are represented.
Protocol Cards describe how they use Turn, Wisdom, Skill, Node, Capability, and Avatar cards.
Protocol relationships are visible in Focus View.

payload.title: Upgrade lighting and Blender-inspired containers
payload.description: Brighten the scene and add procedural card containers derived from the Blender reference scene materials and shape language.
acceptance: Scene is brighter and easier to read.
Card containers include trim, sockets, hologram panes, and crystals inspired by the Blender manifest.
Build and browser smoke test pass after visual changes.

payload.title: Second production pass checkpoint
payload.summary: Card Relationship Lab now has card-type profiles, scope profiles, Protocol Cards, Wisdom Card seed, brighter lighting, and Blender-inspired procedural containers.
verified: npm run build passed
In-app browser sees 18 card rows and protocol stat 12
Protocol filter selects Protocol Design / Governance Loops and shows utilization rules
390px viewport has no horizontal overflow
open: Live SQLite snapshot exporter remains ready
Full all-card loading should be virtualized before broad data import

payload.reason: Read-only sqlite3 exporter writes a browser-loadable card graph snapshot with counts, coverage, families, top cards, top skills, protocol rows, nodes, agents, and bridge kinds.

payload.title: Expose full-card coverage through Atlas tab
payload.description: Expose complete Second Brain card coverage as virtualized summaries while keeping the 3D scene curated.
acceptance: Atlas tab explains why the 3D scene is curated.
Card type coverage lists all represented and profile-ready families.
Snapshot summary updates top-level counts after load.

payload.title: Snapshot atlas checkpoint
payload.summary: The app now generates and loads a read-only Second Brain snapshot instead of relying only on static graph seed data.
verified: npm run export:snapshot wrote public/data/card-graph-snapshot.json
npm run build passed
Browser Atlas tab loaded 8 coverage tiles and 29 summary rows
Top stats updated to 6106 turns, 409 skills, 51 protocol clusters, 109 nodes, and 11658 bridges
open: Add row-level virtualized search and selected-card detail paging
Keep the 3D scene curated under the max scene-card policy

payload.title: Bring in animated MVP card containers
payload.description: Copy and runtime-load the higher quality animated GLB card containers from the MVP/reference Blender project.
acceptance: Animated GLB container assets are copied into the app runtime.
Each card resolves to a high-quality container template with procedural fallback.
Browser QA confirms animated containers and mixers are active.

payload.title: Animated GLB container checkpoint
payload.summary: The Card Relationship Lab now uses the MVP/reference animated GLB card containers as the primary card shell layer, with procedural containers retained as fallback.
verified: npm run build passed
Browser QA reported 5 container templates loaded
Browser QA reported 18 animated containers attached and 0 procedural fallbacks
Browser QA reported 18 active animation mixers
open: Tune material exposure if future lighting passes make GLB shells too bright
Consider meshopt/Draco compression before expanding beyond 18 visible cards

payload.title: Use upright Blender card-face family
payload.description: Correct the MVP/reference card container interpretation from flat tabletop shells to upright Blender card faces, including the legendary device reference and sibling variants.
acceptance: Legendary device and sibling upright reference GLBs are available in runtime assets.
Final animated pass renders upright instead of being flattened onto the table.
Browser QA confirms final animated and static reference passes load without fallbacks.

payload.title: Upright card-face checkpoint
payload.summary: The Card Relationship Lab now renders the Blender Hapa card device family as upright card faces with runtime material remapping for dark tungsten, pale-gold rails, neon state channels, crystals, and hologram panes.
verified: npm run build passed
Browser QA final-animated reported 5 templates, 18 attached containers, 0 fallbacks, and 18 active mixers
Browser QA reference-upright reported 5 templates, 18 attached containers, 0 fallbacks, and 0 mixers as expected for static GLBs
Captured QA screenshot to outputs/hapa-card-relationship-lab-upright-card-faces.png
